access.deniedHint: Insurer settings and coverage rules need the insurance grant. Ask the insurance team's administrator.

payerMark.fillsHint: Used only when the insurer did not send this value.
payerMark.overridesHint: Replaces the value the insurer sent. Shown on the invoice and recorded.

category.title: Insurance categories
category.order: The first rule that matches a line sets its category; with none, the item master's category stands. Pricing then picks the deductible group from it.
category.ifHint: the line, the insurer and the patient

coverage.title: Coverage rules
coverage.order: For each value, the first rule (in this order) that holds and may set it wins: any rule where the insurer said nothing, only a rule marked to override where it did.
coverage.ifHint: the line, the policy and the insurer's answer

ruleset.failed: The rules could not be read.
ruleset.saveFailed: The draft could not be saved
ruleset.stale: Reload the draft to see their changes. Your unsaved changes will be lost.
ruleset.pick: Pick a rule to edit it.
ruleset.pendingLocked: The draft is waiting for approval: it cannot be saved until it is approved or sent back.

checks.failed: The draft could not be checked

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: The draft has changes that are not saved.
leave.settingsBody: The insurer's settings have changes that are not saved.

conditions.empty: No condition: the rule matches every line.
conditions.notHint: Turn the condition around: it holds when this does not.
conditions.codesHint: Codes separated by commas; end one with * to match a prefix (E11*).

level.line: A line value: the rule may read the line.
level.invoice: An invoice value: the rule may not read the line (item, quantity, list of items).

insurers.title: Insurer settings
insurers.hint: One row per insurer (its SAP customer id) and the estate default every insurer inherits where its own value is 0 or empty. Changes are not versioned or approved; every save is logged.
insurers.failed: The insurers could not be read.

settings.benefitsHint: What each code in the eligibility answer means to pricing, and where it is read.
settings.pinsHint: Payer names that always resolve to this insurer.
settings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved
settings.isNew: No settings for this insurer yet: it inherits the estate default. Fill in what differs and create its row.
settings.inheritHint: A 0 or an empty value inherits the estate default.
settings.estateHint: Every insurer inherits these values where its own is 0 or empty.
settings.patternHint: A pattern the id must match, for example ^\d{15}$. Leave empty to inherit.
settings.fullQuantityReturnsOnly: Returns only of the full quantity
settings.brandMaxWhenZero: Brand maximum when the benefit is zero

log.title: Change log
log.failed: The log could not be read.

problem.memberIdLength: Membership id lengths are whole numbers, and the least is not above the most.
problem.memberIdPattern: The membership id pattern is not a valid pattern.
problem.daysSupplyRange: Days of supply are whole numbers, and the least is not above the most.
problem.daysSupplyDefault: The default days of supply is between the least and the most.
problem.benefitCodeTwice: This code is already mapped from the same place.
problem.pinTwice: This payer name is already pinned.

ruleProblem.noEffect: The rule sets nothing yet: pick one value.
ruleProblem.oneEffect: A rule sets one value only: split it into one rule per value.
ruleProblem.invoiceReadsLine: An invoice value cannot read the line: remove the item and line conditions, or set a line value.
